verdicts.reason: Both drop the lime circle out from behind the shoe, so the original's hero composition is lost and the shoe floats alone. Both also set 'Full review inside.' almost as large as the headline, which flattens the hierarchy. In A, the circle sits jammed into the bottom-right corner and the NEW VIDEO badge half-overlaps it, which reads as an accidental collision rather than deliberate layering. B is worse: the circle drifts to the very bottom, cut off from everything, and the badge floats alone with big dead gaps around it. B's logo is also tinier and hard to read.
